businessSummary.en: Company-operated fast-casual restaurants; new units and comparable-store sales drive growth, with labor and food costs affecting margins.
businessSummary.zh: 直营快餐餐厅；新店与同店销售推动增长，人工及食材成本影响利润率。

growth.en: New restaurant openings and comparable sales support 9% starting growth. A 17% company operating margin includes corporate overhead, food, labor and stock compensation; it is not restaurant-level margin.
growth.zh: 新店开业与同店销售支持9%的起始增长。17%的公司营业利润率包含总部、食材、人工及股权薪酬；并非餐厅层面利润率。

targetMargin.en: New restaurant openings and comparable sales support 9% starting growth. A 17% company operating margin includes corporate overhead, food, labor and stock compensation; it is not restaurant-level margin.
targetMargin.zh: 新店开业与同店销售支持9%的起始增长。17%的公司营业利润率包含总部、食材、人工及股权薪酬；并非餐厅层面利润率。

tax.en: Normalized forward operating tax assumption; historical effective tax remains reported in history.
tax.zh: 前瞻正常化营业税率假设；历史有效税率仍按申报保留。

salesCapital.en: Analyst reinvestment assumption informed by the historical book-capital proxy. Incremental sales require new operating capital; accounting acquisitions and buybacks can distort historical ratios.
salesCapital.zh: 依据历史账面资本代理指标设定的分析师再投资假设。新增销售需要新增经营资本；并购会计与回购可能扭曲历史比率。

wacc.en: Analyst required-return assumption reflecting business cyclicality and financing risk; not a quoted market measurement.
wacc.zh: 反映业务周期及融资风险的分析师必要回报假设，并非市场报价测量值。

terminalGrowth.en: Long-run nominal growth assumption below the discount rate; competitive growth fades as the business matures.
terminalGrowth.zh: 低于折现率的长期名义增长假设；随着业务成熟，竞争性增长逐渐放缓。

terminalROIC.en: Analyst mature return on new capital; preserves reinvestment needed to fund terminal growth rather than assuming growth is free.
terminalROIC.zh: 分析师对成熟期新增资本回报率的假设；保留支持永续增长所需的再投资，不假设增长无需投入。

years.en: These are analyst starting assumptions, not company guidance or reported facts. Growth fades toward the terminal rate; stock-based compensation remains an expense.
years.zh: 这些是分析师起始假设，并非公司指引或申报事实。增长逐步收敛至永续增长率；股权薪酬仍计入费用。
